title: GD-COMET: A Geo-Diverse Commonsense Inference Model

bias_targets.methodology: Intrinsic human evaluation of model-generated commonsense inferences by annotators from five diverse cultures (India, South Korea, Nigeria, Iran, Indonesia) based on cultural relevance and stereotype avoidance, alongside extrinsic evaluation measuring accuracy on a geo-diverse visual commonsense reasoning benchmark (GD-VCR) spanning multiple regions (West, South Asia, Africa, East Asia).
